messages:
maria: Heads-up — CI finished for release branch `release/v2.3.0` and produced artifacts. I plan to create an annotated tag and a draft GH release in ~30m unless anyone sees blockers. Please verify checksums and that the changelog entry is accurate.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅ (build, integration, macos) — artifacts uploaded to builds/redwood/v2.3.0/ (sha256 checksums attached).

sam: I can sanity-check the checksums and upload signed checksums. Will run `sha256sum` now.

sam: checksum results:
```
1a2b3c4d5e6f7g8h9i0j...  redwood-server-linux-amd64.tar.gz
9f8e7d6c5b4a3a2b1c0d...  redwood-web-ui.zip
```
Looks consistent with CI metadata.

jess: Quick question — did the `package.json` version bump land on `main`? I saw a commit in the release branch but want to make sure we didn't miss the hotfix PR.

maria: Yes, version bump PR #392 merged into `release/v2.3.0` earlier today. The hotfix for telemetry was merged into `release/v2.3.0` as well; not on `main` yet.

lauren: For the annotated tag message, can we use the standard template? I want the changelog excerpt and notable breaking changes in the tag body so ops sees it in git history.

mike: Template I usually use:
```
Release v2.3.0

- Changelog: short summary bullets (see CHANGELOG.md)
- Notable: telemetry hotfix, improved batching kernel selection
- Artifacts: linux, mac, windows (sha256 listed)
- CI: commit abc123 (checksum verified)
```
Command to create annotated tag and push:
```
git tag -a v2.3.0 -m "Release v2.3.0 — telemetry hotfix, perf tweaks"
git push origin v2.3.0
```
And to create a draft GH release with assets (using `gh`):
```
gh release create v2.3.0 --draft --title "v2.3.0" --notes-file ./release-notes.md \
  --attach builds/redwood/v2.3.0/redwood-server-linux-amd64.tar.gz \
  --attach builds/redwood/v2.3.0/redwood-web-ui.zip
```

sam: I'll also upload `checksums.txt` and `checksums.txt.sig` to the release artifacts and put the sha256 list in the release notes.

jess: QA — can you do a quick staging smoke after sam uploads signed checksums? We should catch any CI artifact mismatch before I approve the tag.

qa-bot: staging-deploy: smoke tests started on `staging/v2.3.0` — running basic flow tests.

qa-bot: smoke results: all green ✅ (login, embeddings, generation sanity).

maria: Sounds good. I'm holding the tag until 11:15 UTC to let sam and QA finish. If everything is green at 11:10 UTC I'll create the annotated tag and push, then mike can run the GH release creation command.

mike: I'll be ready. Also reminder: add the signed checksum and a short note in the release body with the `gpg --verify` instructions for users.

lauren: tiny nit — changelog line under "Bugfixes" should reference issue #678 not #687. Sam, can you fix and re-generate release-notes.md?

sam: on it, pushing a one-line changelog fix now.

maria: Thanks. Everyone, if no objections by 11:12 UTC I will proceed with the tag at 11:15 UTC. :thumbsup:

jess: :thumbsup:

mike: :+1:

deploy-bot: release: annotate-tag scheduled at 1791246900 (automated note).
